name: ClinkCreateQueue

parameters.help_en: The call center ID
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫中心 id
parameters.name: enterprise_id

parameters.help_en: The queue number. It must be a unique 4-digit number
parameters.help_zh: 队列工号，4 位数字，要求唯一
parameters.name: qno

parameters.help_en: The queue name. It can contain only Chinese characters, letters, digits, and underscores, and can be up to 20 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 队列名称，只允许输入中文，字母，数字，下划线，长度不超过 20 个字符
parameters.name: name

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of waiting calls. Valid values: 0 to 999. A value of 0 indicates no limit. Default value: 5
parameters.help_zh: 最大等待数，设置范围 0-999，0 表示不做任何限制。默认值为 5
parameters.name: max_wait

parameters.help_en: The agent timeout period in seconds. Valid values: 20 to 60. Default value: 25
parameters.help_zh: 座席超时时间，取值范围 20-60 秒。默认值为 25
parameters.name: member_timeout

parameters.help_en: The queue timeout period in seconds. Valid values: 30 to 600. Default value: 600
parameters.help_zh: 队列超时时间，取值范围 30-600 秒。默认值为 600
parameters.name: queue_timeout

parameters.help_en:
The call routing strategy. Valid values:
1: Sequential.
2: Round-robin.
3: Average.
4: Random.
5: Skill priority.
6: Longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call.
7: Skill priority + longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call.
8: Longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call (entire queue).
9: Skill priority + longest cumulative idle time since the last inbound call (entire queue).
10: Average across the entire queue.
11: Skill priority + round-robin.
12: Longest idle time.
13: Skill priority + longest current idle time.
14: Longest cumulative idle time since the last call.
Default value: 2
parameters.help_zh: 呼叫策略， 1：顺序，2：轮选，3：平均，4：随机，5：技能优先，6：距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长，7：技能优先+距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长，8：距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长(全队列)，9：技能优先+距上一通呼入空闲时间累计最长(全队列)，10：全队列平均，11：技能优先+轮选，12：最长空闲时长，13：技能优先+当前空闲状态时长最长，14：距上一通通话空闲时间累计最长，默认值为 2
parameters.name: strategy

parameters.help_en: The queue priority. Valid values: 1 to 10. Default value: 1. If an agent belongs to multiple queues, calls from the queue with a higher priority are answered first. A larger value indicates a higher priority
parameters.help_zh: 队列优先级，取值范围 1-10。默认值为 1 座席属于多个队列时，优先级高的队列的来电将优先接听；数值越高，优先级越高
parameters.name: weight

parameters.help_en: The wrap-up time in seconds. Valid values: 3 to 300. During the wrap-up period, the agent does not receive new calls. Default value: 15
parameters.help_zh: 整理时长，取值范围 3-300 秒，整理期间座席不接受新的呼叫。默认值为 15
parameters.name: wrapup_time

parameters.help_en: The service level threshold in seconds. Valid values: 10 to 30. Calls answered within this time are considered to have a high service level. Default value: 15
parameters.help_zh: 服务水平秒数，取值范围 10-30 秒，低于此时间内接听的认为是高服务水平。默认值为 15
parameters.name: service_level

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow joining the queue when it is empty. Valid values:
1: Busy.
2: On a call.
4: Ringing.
8: Invalid.
16: Wrap-up.
To select multiple statuses, pass the sum of the corresponding values. For example, to select Busy and On a call, set the value to 3. Default value: 0, which indicates that no status is selected
parameters.help_zh: 队列中为空时是否可以join，1: 置忙；2: 通话中；4: 振铃；8: 无效；16: 整理 如选多种状态则传对应数值的和，如选置忙和通话中，值为 3。默认值为 0，即都未选中
parameters.name: join_empty

fields.help_en: The agent number in the queue
fields.name: cno

fields.help_en: The priority of the agent in the queue
fields.help_zh: 该座席在队列中的优先级
fields.name: penalty

parameters.help_en: The agents in the queue and their skill levels. Valid skill levels: 1 to 10, where 1 indicates the highest priority. Cno represents the agent number in the queue, and Penalty represents the agent's priority in the queue
parameters.help_zh: 队列内座席及技能值设置。技能值 1-10，技能值 1 的优先级为最高 cno 队列下座席号 penalty该座席在队列中的优先级
parameters.name: queue_members

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow inbound calls to the queue. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes.
Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 是否允许呼入队列，0: 否；1: 是；默认值为 1
parameters.name: ib_allowed

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to announce the agent number. Valid values:
0: No.
1: Yes.
Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 是否报座席号，0: 否；1:是；默认值为 0
parameters.name: say_cno

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to prioritize VIP customers. Valid values:
0: Not supported.
1: Supported.

parameters.help_zh: VIP客户优先，0:不支持；1:支持；默认值为 0

parameters.help_en:

0: Percentage.

parameters.help_en: The limit value for the maximum number of concurrent busy agents. If the limit type is set to percentage, the maximum value is 100. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 最大并发置忙座席数，配置值，当配置类型为百分比时最大值为100，默认值为 0

parameters.help_en:
The online chat routing strategy. Valid values:

4: Random.

parameters.help_zh: 在线客服分配策略，2：轮选；4：随机；5：技能优先；默认值为 2
